points.description: States the inorder order: traverse the left subtree first, then visit the root, then traverse the right subtree (left, root, right), in any wording.
points.partial_credit: Half or more of the marks if the order is vague or has a minor error (e.g. names left, root, right but not as subtrees, or only partly ordered); none if the order is wrong (e.g. root first or last).

points.description: Makes clear that the left and right parts are subtrees traversed in the same way (recursively), or that the root is visited between them.
points.partial_credit: Award if the root is clearly placed between left and right; otherwise none.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating left subtree, then root, then right subtree in any wording, even briefly ("left, root, right"). Part marks for a vague or partly stated order, or one with a minor error. No marks if the order is wrong (preorder or postorder) or the answer only describes trees in general.
